items.prompt: Why is the toy FIFO order ranking not a real-venue adapter?

options.text: It sorts only by arrival time, so the missing detail is more accurate clock precision
options.why: A more precise timestamp cannot supply omitted eligibility, hidden-interest and allocation semantics.

options.text: Every exchange must allocate only by order size
options.why: That is not a universal rule.

options.text: Every hidden order has the same policy everywhere

options.why: The toy deliberately excludes these rule-specific details.

items.explanation: A working sort proves only the stated synthetic comparison, not venue-compatible execution.
